MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 14
   C. 11
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

3. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

4. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 3

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 16

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 13

10. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

13. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

17. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

18. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
